description: The last complete week carried forward, as the reference.
One renewal on the national total, no truncation.
decision: Dropped as a candidate: national scores no better than persistence, and it gives no provinces.

description: A renewal per province with case, Rt a national walk plus pooled deviations.
decision: Kept: province forecasts and pooling, with national scores as S0.

description: Right truncation of the total by the hub's own delay.
decision: Kept: the largest gain, national CRPS down by about three quarters on simulated data and by a third on real.

description: Known and imputed onsets as two streams, with time-varying delays and missingness and the hub's imputation modelled.
decision: Kept on the fuller-model rule: scores level with S2, and it models the imputed stream and changing delays the target depends on.

description: Gravity importation between provinces and an importation-only part for provinces with no cases.
decision: Kept on the fuller-model rule: scores level, it learns across provinces and forecasts spread to new ones.
Kept and chosen as `renewal`: fewer wild prior draws (0.44 to 0.32) and the best province scores of the build.

description: A sum-to-zero report day-of-week effect on the delay hazard.
decision: An option, not the default: no score gain, slower and with a higher R-hat.

description: Delays and missingness fixed from the data, no coupling.
decision: Kept as the fallback: best real-vintage scores and fastest full model, but worse on simulated data with changing delays.

description: Gravity decay and destination weights learnt.
decision: An option for the backtest: scores slightly worse than gravity and it mixes no better.

description: Rt held at its last value past the data.
decision: An option for the backtest: level with the walk, slightly better on the real vintage.

description: One importation share per origin, partially pooled.
decision: An option for the backtest: level with one shared share and fewer depth-cap hits on real data.
Dropped: worse on the real vintage and no gain on simulated data.

description: BVDOutbreakSize Rt as a tempered pseudo-observation.
decision: Shadow candidate: best on simulated data with a truth-based BVD summary, worse on the one real vintage.

description: An independent single-patch renewal per location, the nation included.
decision: Comparison variant: province scores level with renewal on the real vintage, but its own national fit did not converge (R-hat 2.2) and scores far worse.
